units.source_text: “我已经连庭院也去不了啦，所以希望在本馆进行。

en.t: I can no longer even go out to the garden, so I would like it to be held in the main building.

units.source_text: 不过，上次大竹说过，本馆这边瀑布声太大，还是请你问问大竹吧。

en.t: But last time Otake said that the sound of the waterfall is too loud on this side of the main building, so please ask Otake about it after all.
It would be best to do it according to Otake's opinion.
